rule: docs/TREE_PLAN.md: one yard tree for every two or three houses, in back yards and at lot corners, never against a fence or a wall (zone 813 -> about 400)
written: by hand, 19 Nov 2026 (cloud session, the city-wide superchecker run from the bottom of the list). The quadrant's sixteen builder trees go (corals and canary date palms along the back fences, queen, fan palms and corals 3-4 m from the house fronts, magnolias and a jacaranda by the seating); four come back on their own spots, about one for every two houses: by the two grills, the arbor, and one back yard.

trees.why: the back yard with the kettle grill and the white adirondack: a magnolia over both
the west back yard's kettle grill (1.6 m off): a jacaranda over the cook
the south-west yard with the garden arbor (2.5 m off): a magnolia beside it
the south back yard, 7 m from the house: the yard's tree
